REQUEST
Create a character-design prompt for an adult lighthouse keeper. Give her weathered olive skin, tightly curled gray hair, a navy cable-knit sweater, orange waterproof bib trousers, black rubber boots, and a brass whistle on a cord. Describe character design only. Return one prompt with no scene, pose, expression, action, camera, lighting, weather, or story.

OUTPUT A
An adult female lighthouse keeper with weathered olive skin and tightly curled gray hair. Her clothing consists of a navy cable-knit sweater, orange waterproof bib trousers, and black rubber boots, with a brass whistle on a cord around her neck.

questions.question:
REVIEW 41/48 — pair-11ea54b4181c

REQUEST
Write one Wan text-to-video prompt. A yellow paper boat drifts along a narrow rain-filled gutter beside a gray curb; raindrops ripple the water and push tiny leaves past it. The camera makes a slow low tracking move alongside the boat, then gently pulls back as it reaches a storm drain. Photorealistic macro cinematography, cool overcast light. Return one cohesive paragraph only, with no shot list, label, notes, variants, or generation.

OUTPUT A
A yellow paper boat drifts along a narrow rain-filled gutter beside a gray curb, gently bobbing as raindrops spread overlapping ripples and push tiny leaves past its folded hull. In one continuous move, the camera tracks slowly alongside at water level, then gently pulls back as the boat reaches a storm drain, revealing water streaming between the dark metal bars. Photorealistic macro cinematography, shallow depth of field, crisp paper folds, wet concrete textures, and soft reflections under cool overcast light.

OUTPUT B
A yellow paper boat drifts along a narrow rain-filled gutter beside a gray curb, its folded paper texture sharply visible as raindrops spread overlapping ripples across the water and push tiny leaves past it. In one continuous low, water-level tracking move, the camera slowly follows alongside the boat, then gently pulls back as it reaches a storm drain, widening the view of the gutter in photorealistic macro cinematography with shallow depth of field and cool, soft overcast light.

CRITERION C14-ROUTE (hard)
The output follows the existing Wan route as one cohesive cinematic paragraph rather than a shot list or image prompt.
